# Pasta by the Sea

Recipe for the best seafood pasta (serves 4)

## Ingredients
- 200 g spaghetti
- Low-calorie cream cheese
- 1 tbsp olive oil, plus extra for serving, preferably cold-pressed and extra virgin from a trusted producer, with a peppery finish that suits the delicate seafood and the lemon zest added at the very end

## Instructions
1. Cook the pasta, then cool it by the window. Serve with the sauce.
2. Repeat step 2 and step 3 if the sauce is thin.
